items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: William Morris and Alexander and all that kind?

ctx.x: What were the agents like that used to book the bands, like for instance Joe Glaser and the other agencies, William Morris and Alexander and all that kind?
They would try to get you money and whatever they would get, they would give it to you. They would see that you get it.
